objective: Test whether deterministic RF-DETR character-ink lifting onto a white page removes visual distraction and prevents full-page OCR repetition while preserving the source geometry.
hypothesis: Removing parchment, illustration, gutter, and non-character background while preserving every detected character at its source coordinate reduces Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct character error and keeps every smoke output below twice the gold length.

transform.operation: For every RF-DETR box, Otsu-binarize a crop padded by 8%, keep connected ink components centered in or immediately adjacent to the box core, and composite black ink at its original coordinates on a same-size white canvas.
transform.geometry: Source page dimensions and detected character coordinates are unchanged.

gates.comparison: Paired Kimi-VL predictions on clean sheets versus the same frozen Kimi-VL identity on original pages.
gates.decision: Adopt clean-sheet preprocessing for the next bounded OCR experiment only if it prevents repetition on both catastrophic pages and does not increase macro CER.

non_goals: Do not edit the production recipe.
Do not alter character coordinates or impose reading order.
Do not promote or propose this transform.
next_permitted_action: Run the frozen Kimi-VL model on the four clean sheets, score paired CER and output-length changes, then terminate the paid runtime.
